name: Carbon-fibre rods, 6 mm x 400 mm
spec: Solid or thick-wall tube, 6 mm dia
notes: Cut to 400 mm, deburr, seal ends with CA.

name: Stack plates (battery, PCB, telemetry)
notes: Print flat, 4 perimeters, 40% gyroid.

name: Landing frame (diamond plate with four hinge lugs)
notes: 133 mm diamond, corners on the leg axes

name: Landing legs 8 mm x 260 mm + rubber feet (hinge fittings printed)
spec: Carbon or aluminium tube, hinged at the corner lugs
notes: 34 deg from vertical, footprint 510 mm

name: Leg braces (1.6 mm steel or CF rod)
spec: From gimbal mount to leg mid-point

name: Gimbal printed parts (mount, outer ring, collar, two servo brackets)
notes: STL files in hardware/cad/stl/rocket. See docs/cad-parts.md.

name: Pinion 18T, module 1 (printed PA12 / acetal, or metal)
spec: Acetal, nylon or printed PA; CAD names gear36t1 / gear36t2
notes: The two 36T sectors are printed into the outer ring and the collar. Check backlash; keep spares.

name: Digital metal-gear servo, 20 g class, HV
notes: Buy a spare.

name: Pivot hardware: M3 bolts (2 x 20 mm, 2 x 16 mm), nylock nuts, 683ZZ bearings
spec: Stainless button-head M3, 3x7x3 mm bearings (one per pivot)
notes: Bolt is clamped to the fixed part, the bearing rides in the moving boss. Tighten until the bearing just drags, back off 1/8 turn.

name: Service-loop cable for servo 2
notes: Servo 2 rides on the outer ring.

name: Brushless motor 3110, about 900 KV (coaxial pair)
spec: 6S rated, 5 mm shaft, prop adapters for CW and CCW
notes: Static thrust about 1.5 kgf each with a 9 in prop on 6S (recorded on the stand at Gate B).

name: Propellers 9x4.5, one CW and one CCW
spec: Matched pair, balanced. Upper prop (below its motor) is a pusher type, lower prop (above its motor) is a standard type; both blow air downward
notes: Contra-rotating pair: reaction torques cancel.

name: Spare propellers 9x4.5 (2 CW + 2 CCW)
notes: The first crash breaks one.

name: ESC 40 A, 6S, 400 Hz PWM (BLHeli_S / AM32)
notes: Set the directions in the configurator before the first spin.

name: Motor mount: Ø42 carbon tube, printed plates, arms, struts and guard ring
spec: Carbon tube 58 mm + printed plates, 3 struts and a Ø246 mm guard ring
notes: Holds motor A above the props and motor B below.

name: Power distribution board + 1000 uF 35 V capacitors + XT60
spec: Two ESC feeds, capacitor close to each ESC

name: LiPo 6S 1500 mAh, 75C+, XT60 (main pack)
notes: Feeds the ESCs and, through BECs, the servos.

name: LiPo 2S 450 mAh (avionics pack)
notes: Keeps the flight computer and log alive and electrically isolated from ESC noise.

name: Servo BEC 7.4 V / 5 A (from the 6S pack)
notes: Servos are HV rated.

name: 5 V / 3 A regulator (logic, from the 2S pack)
Fuse 5 A (servo BEC) + remove-before-flight pin + arm switch
spec: RBF pin breaks the main-pack supply: removable with gloves

name: Wiring harness, connectors, heat shrink
spec: 12-14 AWG motor and power leads, 26-28 AWG signals, locking connectors
notes: No bare Dupont connectors on a rocket: vibration.

name: IMU ICM-42688-P
notes: Mount near the stack axis.

name: Barometer BMP390
notes: Vent the frame; avoid sealed cavities.

name: ExpressLRS 2.4 GHz receiver + antenna
spec: CRSF over UART, link statistics on the radio
notes: Antenna on the top plate, clear of the carbon rods.

name: GPS u-blox M10 module
notes: Top plate, antenna clear of carbon rods.

name: microSD card
notes: Logs are how you tune.

name: Fasteners (M3/M4/M5, nylock, washers, inserts)
notes: Counts per part are in docs/cad-parts.md (hardware list). About 23 M3 inserts, 75 M3 screws, 50 M3 nuts (8 nylock).

name: Test stand: base, column, 20 kg load cell + HX711
notes: See docs/phase2-rocket/07-test-stand-procedure.md

name: Prop shield: polycarbonate panel or net cage
notes: Props shed fragments.

name: Current-limited bench supply or smoke stopper
spec: Limit to 2-3 A for the first power-up

name: ELRS transmitter / radio
spec: Any EdgeTX radio with an ELRS module
notes: Skip if you already own one.

name: Balance charger + LiPo safe bag (6S capable)
Tether kit: 3 x 3 m line, anchors, swivel
Fire extinguisher, gloves, eye protection
notes: Required at every powered test.
